text: In a country house, young Rosaleen dreams of an old forest where wolves kill her sister, and her grandmother knits her a red shawl and warns her [never to stray from the path|archetypes|Stray From the Path] or trust a man whose eyebrows meet. Granny's tales tell of [grooms who turn into wolves|threat|the body turning monstrous] and of [a potion from the Devil that sprouts hair on a boy's chest|origin|bargains with dark powers]. On the way to the cottage Rosaleen meets a huntsman whose eyebrows meet, and her fear becomes tangled with [desire for him|wants|lust and indulgence].
